subject: physical-education
instructions: Complete the safe activity or accessible equivalent and document the requested performance evidence.
Stop for pain, dizziness, breathing trouble, unsafe conditions, or missing adult supervision.

learnerTasks.prompt: Explain racquet paddle or target skills in your own words and give or identify a valid example.
Use a diagram, model, quotation, data display, map, demonstration, or worked process to show understanding of wrestling-style stance and movement without unsafe contact.
Apply martial-arts-inspired forms without combat in a new realistic situation. Show the process or cite evidence.
Analyze a plausible error, weak claim, unsafe choice, or design flaw involving skill routines; correct it and explain why.
Connect racquet paddle or target skills with personal challenge design. Explain how the ideas support, constrain, contrast with, or build on one another.
Present the strongest evidence from the unit project: Develop and demonstrate a safe progressive routine in an individual or dual activity.
Identify one skill you can now transfer, one check that improves accuracy or quality, and one next question.

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated accuracy or fidelity criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated evidence and reasoning criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated application or performance criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated checking and revision criterion.
accommodations: Access supports may change format, pacing, quantity, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed.

provenance.unitObjective: How can the learner demonstrate the goals of Individual and Dual Activities?
